name: Project Artifact
description: Generate and publish a living project status page — overview & success criteria, the workstream sequence, and next steps — as a shareable claude.ai artifact backed by a per-project config, so refreshes re-gather live state, redeploy the same URL, and report only the delta.
longDescription: Builds a **living project status page** — overview and success criteria, the workstream sequence, an always-visible next-steps strip, plus optional background, plan, risks and FAQ tabs — as a single self-contained HTML file published through Claude Code's built-in `Artifact` tool. Run `/project-artifact`, point it at the repo, PRs, tracker or design doc; say "refresh the artifact" later and it re-gathers live state, redeploys to the **same URL** and reports only the delta. Ships one skill (`SKILL.md`, `swe.md`, `template.html`); PR-driven projects pull live CI and review state via the `gh` CLI. Requires a claude.ai login (Team/Enterprise beta).
